text:
1 ” to allow audio playback *Music* Hello learner welcome to grade four Christian Religious Education Programme. Today we are going to talk about obedience at home. We are going to talk about obedience at home. The radio teacher is Purity Mukuhi Welcome to the programme. *Music*

2 ” to allow audio playback Hello grade 4 learner, today we shall talk about obedience at home. Before we start our lesson what did we learn about truthfulness? #b ell # Learner, have you remembered about what we learnt concerning truthfulness? #b ell # Good, This is what you should have learnt: One: When we tell lies, we get caught after some time. T w o: That lies are soon forgotten but the truth last forever. Three: We should always tell the truth since this is what the Bible commands us to do. Four: We feel at peace because we are not guilty for lying. Five: It makes other people trust us. Six: It helps us to easily make and keep friends. Seven: Our friends and teachers can help us tell the truth always. #m usic # Today we are going to learn about Obedience at home. What is obedience? # Bell # Obedience means doing what you are told to do gladly. Obedience also means following instructions. Obedience is a way of showing respect to the people around us. We respect our parents and siblings when we obey them. The Bible teaches us that as Christians we must be obedient at all times. Obedience is one of God’s commandments given to Moses at Mount Sinai. Learner, do you have Bible next to you? I will give you time to open Exodus 20 : 12. Exodus 20 : 12. #m usic # Learner welcome back. Did you open Exodus 20 : 12 ? Good, let’s now read. Exodus 20 : 12 Respect your father and your mother so that you may live a long time in the land that I am giving you. Respect your father and your mother so that you may live a long time in the land that I am giving you. So learners who are we supposed to respect? #b ell # Learner did you say father and mother or our parents or guardians. #b ell #

3 ” to allow audio playback Good. What is the main reason for respecting them? #b ell # I hope you said we should respect our parents or guardians so as to live long here on earth. God commands us to respect our parents. If we do that we shall live a long life. Parents here means our elders. #m usic # Today we have learnt that: One: God commands us to obey our parents. T w o: God promises that if we obey them we shall live a long life. Three: It is our Christian duty to respect our parents. Four: When we respect our parents we obey God. Five: We respect our parents and siblings when we obey them. Learner there are several reasons as to why we should obey our parents. What happens when we obey our parents? One: We live peacefully with them. T w o: We make them happy. Three: It shows that we respect them. Four: We make them feel loved and appreciated. #m usic # Now let’s open our Bibles again to memorize and recite Ephesians 6: 1- 2. Let’s memorize and recite Ephesians chapter 6: 1-2. Ephesians 6: 1- 2. “Children, it is your duty to obey your parents, for this is the right thing to do. Respect your father and mother for this is the first commandment that has a promise added. ” “Children, it is your duty to obey your parents, for this is the right thing to do. Respect your father and mother for this is the first commandment that has a promise added. ” #m usic # Welcome back, I hope you have enjoyed the lesson, today we were talking about obedience at home. Learner in your own words write a poem with the title ‘why it good to obey my parents’ . Recite it to your parents and siblings at home. We have now come to the end of our lesson today. #m usic #

4 ” to allow audio playback That was Christian Religious Education for grade 4. The presenter was Purity Mukuhi. The program was written by Geofrey Ratemo. it was produced by the Educational Media Directorate. It was recorded by Johnson Mwangi for the Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development until next time. Goodbye. #m usic #
